name: UniPCB
description: UniPCB is a unified bilingual vision-language benchmark for open-ended printed circuit board quality inspection. It combines PCB inspection imagery with multi-turn visual question answering annotations covering defect recognition, component understanding, spatial grounding, counting, localization, and inspection-oriented analysis.
citeAs: Citation information will be added after release.
rai:dataCollection: UniPCB was constructed by collecting and standardizing PCB inspection data from multiple public or project-provided PCB-related sources, then mapping heterogeneous defect and component information into a unified inspection schema. The released benchmark contains image references and bilingual VQA-style annotations for fully labeled, weakly labeled, and unlabeled inspection settings.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw images are stored under data/benchmark/raw/ and organized by source folder: PCBA, PCB-electric-resistance-Dataset_nodefect, FPIC, Dataset-PCB-CNN, AoI, DeepPCB, PCB-Defect-Detection-using-Image-Registration-master, VisA, solder-joint-dataset-main, and pcb-component-detection. The annotation package is data/benchmark/generated/generate_vqa_bilingual_test/all_vqa_data_bilingual_20260426_190307.json.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Each benchmark record is expected to contain conversation, images, image_size, dataset, dataset_type, and language fields. Image paths should be validated with scripts/dataset/validate_paths.py before release; records whose referenced images are missing should not be used for evaluation.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Repository-relative image paths were normalized under data/benchmark/raw/.
Heterogeneous source labels were mapped into a shared taxonomy of defect and component concepts.
Benchmark records were grouped into P1 fully labeled, P2 weakly labeled, and P3 unlabeled scenario settings.
Questions and answers were packaged as bilingual, multi-turn VQA conversations.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations are released as conversations. Each conversation item includes a question, a correct_option answer, and a task type. Closed-ended questions additionally include options and correct_answer_letter. The benchmark contains 5,736 samples, 6,560 unique image references, and 23,308 QA pairs across 14 inspection subtasks.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Project-specific benchmark generation and review scripts under scripts/benchmark_generation and scripts/manual_review
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The dataset includes bilingual English and Chinese question-answer pairs.
Scenario labels distinguish fully labeled, weakly labeled, and unlabeled inspection settings.

Question types cover defect description, analysis, detection, classification, counting, location, coordinates, component description, component type, component counting, component location, and component coordinates.
rai:annotationsPerItem: Each sample contains one or more conversation items; the current package has 23,308 QA pairs over 5,736 samples.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Project-specific Python scripts in the UniPCB repository
rai:annotatorDemographics: No personal demographic attributes of annotators are included in the released benchmark metadata.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The benchmark is focused on PCB imagery and inspection annotations. It is not intended to contain human subjects or personal sensitive information.
Users should still inspect upstream source data and metadata before redistribution to confirm that no sensitive information is present.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluating vision-language models for PCB quality inspection.
Developing PCB inspection VQA systems for defect recognition, component understanding, spatial grounding, counting, and localization.
Research on bilingual industrial visual question answering.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is an inspection benchmark and should not be treated as a complete representation of all PCB designs, manufacturing processes, defect modes, or deployment environments.
Performance measured on this benchmark may not transfer directly to production inspection lines without additional validation.
The dataset combines multiple sources whose original licensing and redistribution terms must be respected before public release.
The current Croissant license field is set to NOASSERTION because a final project-level dataset license was not present in the repository.
rai:dataBiases: Source datasets may be imbalanced across PCB types, defect categories, component categories, image acquisition conditions, and languages.
The benchmark contains more samples from some source folders than others, so aggregate metrics should be interpreted together with source-level and scenario-level breakdowns.
rai:dataSocialImpact: UniPCB is intended to support reproducible research on PCB quality inspection. Potential positive impacts include improved inspection automation and more transparent model evaluation. Potential risks include over-reliance on benchmark scores without production validation or insufficient attention to upstream dataset licenses.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The benchmark is released as a static snapshot with version 1.0.0. Future updates should increment the version and update file checksums, record counts, source documentation, and this Croissant metadata file.
